classes._comment: Grant-ladder shape: L1 is the starter trio (frost_bolt/quick_cast/light), L2 the first gated grant wave (won_combat:3 -> flame_jet/mana_shield), and [Invisibility] sits at L5 -- a canon Tier-4 second-wave utility verb (see the skill's own `_comment`), so it belongs neither in the L1 starter slot nor L2's combat-power wave; L5 (spell_cast:13, the ladder's midpoint before the L10 evolution branch) keeps it reachable well before evolution without perturbing either. CONSTRAINT: [Invisibility] now carries a real combat read (a self-cast untargetable status) -- MEASURED balance-neutral, not exempt-by-field-only-status: `sim_combat_batch.gd` ran byte-identical before/after wiring it, because `WICombatAI` never selects an `invisibility`-type effect (only ever picks line_damage/spell_damage, see combat_ai.gd's own doc comment) and the harness's PC autoplay is melee-profile (never casts any spell). If AI ever gains a caster profile that could self-cast utility skills, or the PC's autoplay profile changes, re-run `sim_combat_batch.gd` and re-justify the rung.

classes._comment: SPARSE TABLE (GH#54): [Spellsword] is consolidation-only (never gained_by) -- accept_consolidation sets classes[spellsword] directly to the MERGED level (wi_game.gd's `classes[target] = level`), never through check_level_ups counting up from level 1. Floor derivation (read from THIS entry's own min_parent_level/min_combined_level plus WIProgression._consolidation_merged_level's pinned formula `max(ceil(2*(La+Lb)/3), max(La,Lb))` -- not a guessed number): the offer requires BOTH parents >= min_parent_level (6) AND combined >= min_combined_level (13); the minimal sum honoring both floors is 13, and for a fixed sum the most-balanced split minimizes the merge (6,7) -- merged = max(ceil(2*13/3), max(6,7)) = max(9,7) = 9. Floor = 9 (test_progression.gd's own '(6,7) -> 9' boundary case pins this exact scenario). Levels 1-8 intentionally absent -- padding below the derived floor is now a content ERROR (test_content.gd's _validate_class_level_tables). TRAP AVOIDED: the OLD level-1 entry carried `keener_edge` (spellsword's own signature grant) -- since `_own_grants_at_level` includes every entry at or below the held level, trimming level 1 outright would have deleted keener_edge from the kit forever. Migrated onto the new floor entry (level 9) below instead of dropped. GH#61 TOP-END FIX: the table used to stop at 14, but both parent lines cap at their OWN table max of 12 (warrior/swordsman/spearmaster; mage/ice_mage/fire_mage) -- a player who levels BOTH to 12 before consolidating is assigned merged = max(ceil(2*24/3), 12) = 16, which had no levels entry (HP/MP growth and grants silently stopped at the held level, non-crashing but wrong). Levels 15-16 added; test_content.gd's _validate_class_level_tables now enforces this TOP-END reachability generically (table max >= the merge formula's max over both parent lines' own table maxes), so this class of gap can't recur silently. Thresholds continue the L9-14 curve by eye (hand-authored headroom, not a closed formula -- L9-14's own deltas already aren't a clean arithmetic sequence): melee_hit's last delta (92->105) was +13, so 15/16 continue +14/+15 (105->119->134); spell_cast's L9-14 deltas were a clean +1-per-level run (8,9,10,11,12), so 15/16 continue that exact run at +13/+14 (87->100->114). L15 grants [] BY DESIGN -- the capstone intentionally lands at the ceiling (L16) only, so leveling from 15 has one more real step to it, mirroring how every other rung above a class's opening kit sits empty until its own payoff level. L16's [Spellbound Strike] is an INVENTED name, flagged as such: the wiki confirms [Spellsword] itself as attested canon (Pisces calls them 'dubiously qualified' [Swordsman]/[Mage] hybrids; List_of_Classes/S names Edward and Requiel as holders, refs 7.15 R / 7.34 C -- both inside the Book-17 bar), but no single clean canon Skill name/effect for the class survived a wiki search deep enough to attest with confidence (candidates like [Spellstrike Arms] appear in the Skills_Effect index with no confirmed holder, chapter, or mechanical detail to model from). The grant rides the EXISTING damage_mult type (no new effect type) and, unlike keener_edge (weapon:sword only), carries NO weapon gate -- a deliberate choice so every real consolidated spellsword (sword-line OR spear-line parent) can field the capstone, not just half of them. Costs both AP and MP (spellsword's only damage_mult skill that spends MP) -- a genuine capstone tax on the class's whole dual resource pool, not just one tree. Iconless (no hotbar art commissioned for it yet) -- degrades gracefully like the dozen other iconless skills (see flame_pillar's own precedent comment).

classes._comment: [Rogue] -- CANON-VERDICT 2026-07-07 ATTESTED (List_of_Classes/R: base class, holders Foliana/Quietstab; variants [Rogue Leader]/[Rogue Mage]/[Rogue Marksman]/[Ravager Rogue]). USER RULING 4: stealth's home. EARN TRACE (action-driven model, no invented counter for the gate): gained_by is `recovered_crate_watch` (the Missing-Crate WATCH path's own accomplishment -- pointing the Watch sergeant at the scavengers via a classless persuade option, `data/dialogue/watch_crate.json`). Two other existing 'guile' counters were traced and REJECTED for the GATE: `recovered_crate_guile` requires already holding [Light] (a Mage L1 grant) to study `cellar_door` first -- coupling Rogue's earn to Mage is the wrong dependency for an independent action-driven class, unlike every other earned class (warrior/mage/diplomat/helper/tactician all gate on ONE classless action); `scouted_the_nest` requires already holding [Appraise Foe] (a Tactician grant) for the same reason. `recovered_crate_watch` needs only the classless `asked_about_crate` accomplishment -- reachable by any PC, no prerequisite class or skill. CIRCULARITY TRAP (a) AVOIDED: the obvious 'sneak past N dangers' counter was NOT used as the gate because it requires the `sneak` skill's `sneaking` flag to already be true (`_check_trigger_radius` only skips -- and could only bank a counter -- while `sneaking`), and NO class grants `sneak` before Rogue does; gating Rogue's own grant on it would be circular. That counter (`sneaked_past_danger`, added this task as the sanctioned small field-seam touch in `wi_game.gd`'s `_check_trigger_radius`, entity_first_use-deduped per waking, the [Appraise Foe]/[Friendly Face] precedent) is used ONLY for LEVEL-UP past L1, where circularity does not apply (the PC already holds `sneak` by then). ONBOARDING INTEGRITY (b) TRACED: `recovered_crate_watch` is street-quest content (Krshia's Missing Crate, `data/dialogue/watch_crate.json`) reachable only on the `street` map; `street` is reachable only via `floodplains`' `liscor_gate` door (skeleton_scene.json map graph: inn<->floodplains<->street, no direct inn->street door), and `liscor_gate` sits at (31,25), 2 cells from `goblin_encounter_1` (30,23, trigger_radius 2 Chebyshev) -- structurally impossible to reach the gate without first passing through the mandatory ambush's trigger zone. Since class grants resolve only at `sleep()` (never mid-waking), and `recovered_crate_watch` cannot be banked before the street is reached, [Rogue] cannot be granted before `goblin_encounter_1` has already fired for every fresh player -- onboarding integrity holds by map topology, not merely by convention. `sneak`'s grant level is L1 (the same convention every other earned class uses for its signature grant -- mage/warrior/diplomat/tactician all grant at L1), which is POST-onboarding for exactly the reason above. stat_growth dex:1 is the first earned class to grow dex alone (finesse/agility fits the archetype; stats stay hidden from the player regardless). FIXTURE-FIRST canonical: `rogue_earn_loop` (fixture `near_rogue`) proves earn(fixture-preloaded) -> sleep -> class_gained -> [Stealth] fielded end-to-end.
